name: Endeavour (STS-99)
about: Endeavour (STS-99) (2000-010A), a crewed vehicle (OV-105), launched 2000 Feb 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2000 Feb 13), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
